SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND.title: The Dark Hand
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_AH_FEN.title: Dark Hand · Finn
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_BLACK_MARKET_:
Lose {GoldCost} Gold; gain [E] and draw {Magic} card{Magic:plural:|s}; apply 1 *Blackhand* to ALL enemies. Each use this combat increases the Gold cost by 3.
*Blackhand*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_BLAST_DISTRIC:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Consume all *Blackhand* from all enemies. For each stack consumed, that enemy takes {Magic} additional damage. If the total consumed reaches 8 or more, all enemies gain {DebuffAmount} *Vulnerable* and {DebuffAmount} *Weak*.
*Blackhand*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_BOUNTY.title: Bounty
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_BOUNTY.descri:
Whenever you apply *Blackhand*, deal 2 damage to that target. When an enemy with *Blackhand* dies, gain {Magic} Gold.
*Blackhand*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_CHOW.title: Dark Hand · Chow
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_CLOSE_NET.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. For every 5 *Blackhand* consumed from the target, deal that damage again. Current target total damage: {TotalDamage:diff()}.
*Blackhand*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_CODE_PHRASE.d:
If the previous card played was a *Blackhand* card, gain [E] and draw 1 card. Otherwise, gain {Block:diff()} Block.
*Blackhand*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_COERCIVE_INTE:
The target loses *Strength* this turn equal to half its *Blackhand* stacks{IfUpgraded:show:+1|} (current: {StrengthLoss:diff()}), then gains {Magic} *Weak*.
*Blackhand*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_DISTRICT13_IN:
Preview the top {Magic} cards of your draw pile. In the preview area, cards are ordered from left to right as the 1st to the {Magic}th card. Discard any number of them. Gain {BlockPerDiscard} Block for each discarded card. For each kept card, apply 1 *Blackhand* to ALL enemies.
*Blackhand*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_ESCORT.title: Escort
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_ESCORT.descri:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Apply {BlackHandApply} *Blackhand* to ALL enemies. At the start of your next turn, gain Block again equal to total enemy *Blackhand* stacks.
*Blackhand*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_EXTORTION.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain 3 Gold for every 3 *Blackhand* on the target; only if Gold is gained, consume 2 *Blackhand* from it.
*Blackhand*
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. If the target has *Blackhand*, deal an additional {Magic} damage; otherwise, apply {ApplyAmount} *Blackhand*.
*Blackhand*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_NO_NAME_YET.d:
At the start of your turn, apply {BlackHandAmt} *Blackhand* to ALL enemies. Whenever an enemy gains 4 *Blackhand* in one turn, deal {Magic} damage to it and draw 1 card.
*Blackhand*
At the start of your turn, choose 1 card from your discard pile and add it to your hand. That card is treated as a *Blackhand* card this combat.
*Blackhand*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_RATSO.title: Dark Hand · Ratso
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_RATSO.descrip:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
Draw {Cards} card{Cards:plural:|s}, discard {Cards} card{Cards:plural:|s}.
*Blackhand*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-ANCIENT_RATSO.title: Ratso
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-ANCIENT_RATSO.descriptio:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
Draw {Cards} card{Cards:plural:|s}. Status and Curse cards are Exhausted and do not count.
Discard {Cards} card{Cards:plural:|s}; randomly trigger {TriggerCount} discarded card{TriggerCount:plural:|s}.
*Blackhand*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_SIEGE_RAM.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target has at least 3 *Blackhand*, consume all of it. For every 3 stacks consumed, it loses 1 *Strength* and regains it after 2 turns.
*Blackhand*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_SPREAD_RUMORS:
Apply {Magic} *Blackhand* to a target. If it already has *Blackhand*, gain [E].
*Blackhand*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_STRIKE.title: Blackhand Strike
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_STRIKE.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target has no *Blackhand*, apply {Magic} *Blackhand*. Otherwise, draw 1 card and apply {ExistingBlackHandApply} *Blackhand*.
*Blackhand*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_SUPPRESSIVE_F:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. For every 2 *Blackhand* on each enemy, deal 1 additional damage to that enemy.
*Blackhand*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_TOHRU.title: Dark Hand · Tohru
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_TOHRU.descrip:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Apply {BlackHandApply} *Blackhand* to the target.
Damage & Block = Max HP × {Percent}%
+{PerCard}% per *Blackhand* card in deck
*Blackhand*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_VALMONT.title: Dark Hand · Valmont
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_VALMONT.descr:
This card costs 1 less for every 5 *Blackhand* cards in your deck.
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. For each *Blackhand* card played this turn, deal an additional {Magic} damage.
Apply {BlackHandApply} *Blackhand* to the target.
Blackhand stacks = 2 + the number of *Blackhand* cards played this turn.
*Blackhand*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-GAN.title: Gan
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-GAN.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Critical strikes deal 50% additional damage.
Current critical chance: {CritChance}%. Each use increases future *Gan* critical chance by 10%, up to 100%.
*Dark Warrior*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-WEN.title: Wen

*Dark Warrior*

*Ah Fu*

Deal {Damage:diff()} damage *2 times. If an *Ah Fu* card was played this turn, strike 1 additional time. If this card kills an enemy, gain {Magic} *Strength*.
*Ah Fu*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-HEAD_CRACKS_WALNUT.title: Head Cracks the Walnut

*Ah Fu*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-CROW_FLYING.title: Angry Crow Takes Flight

*Ah Fu*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-METEOR_HITS_MOUNTAIN.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Magic} times.
If an *Ah Fu* card was played this turn: Your next attack damage increases by {Bonus}.
*Ah Fu*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-NI_JIA_MASK.title: Oni Mask of Ninja-khan
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-NI_JIA_MASK.description: At the start of your turn, add {Magic} {IfUpgraded:show:*Ninja-khan+*|*Ninja-khan*} to your hand (automatically played if hand is full).
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-NI_JIA_NINJA.title: Ninja-khan
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-NI_JIA_NINJA.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
*Shadowkhan*: not affected by *Strength*, *Dexterity*, *Weak*, or *Vulnerable*; affected only by *Dominion*.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DOUBLE_STICKS.title: Double Sticks
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DOUBLE_STICKS.descriptio:
*Ninja-khan* gains 3 times the damage bonus from *Dominion*.{IfUpgraded:show:
Gain {Magic} *Dominion*.|}
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SHURIKEN.title: Shuriken
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SHURIKEN.description: *Unupgraded Ninja khan* base damage per hit becomes *3*; *upgraded Ninja khan* becomes *5*. It deals damage *{Magic}* times.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SMOKE_BOMB.title: Smoke Bomb
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SMOKE_BOMB.description: Each time *Ninja-khan* {IfUpgraded:show:attacks|deals unblocked damage}, the target temporarily loses {Magic} *Strength* this turn.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-NO_WAY_THROUGH.title: No Way Through
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-NO_WAY_THROUGH.descripti:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
Add {Magic} {IfUpgraded:show:*Ninja Khan+*|*Ninja Khan*} to your hand.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-NINJA_COOPERATION.title: Ninja Cooperation
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-NINJA_COOPERATION.descri: For each Ninja-khan in your exhaust pile, Ninja-khan deals +{Magic} damage per hit.

SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-COMBO_MOVE.title: Combo Move

SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-YI_KA_SAMURAI.title: Samurai-khan
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-YI_KA_SAMURAI.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. You may exhaust 1 card from your hand for a bonus:
Skill = Draw 2 cards
Attack = Deal half its damage
Power = Randomly apply *Weak*, *Vulnerable*, or *Strength* loss
Curse/Quest = *Stun* the target
Status = Apply Poison equal to turn number + 1
Other = Gain 1 Max HP

SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-MASK_FACE.selectionScree: Choose a Mask card to add to your hand.

Mask capacity +1.|}

SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SHADOW_DECREE.title: Shadow Decree
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SHADOW_DECREE.descriptio: Gain {Magic} *Dominion*. Gain *Shadow Decree* (at the start of your turn, lose 1 *Strength*, 1 *Dexterity*, and 1 HP).
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-ENDLESS_DARKNESS.title: Endless Darkness
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-ENDLESS_DARKNESS.descrip:
Expand all *Mask* slot limits to 10, and gain one stack of each of the ten mask effects. Gain 1 *Dominion*. At the start of your turn, gain 1 *Dominion* for every 10 *Shadowkhan* cards in your exhaust pile.{IfUpgraded:show:
Generated *Shadowkhan* cards are upgraded.|}
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-EIGHT_DEMON_POSSESSION_C: Each turn, your first {TriggerCount} Attack cards apply {EffectCount} random effects to their targets: debuffs or *Strength* loss. Normal debuffs apply {NormalAmountMin}-{NormalAmountMax} stacks; *Strength* loss applies {StrengthLossMin}-{StrengthLossMax}.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-HORSE_TALISMAN_EXIT_PREV:
Remove no debuff and do not enter cooldown.
If triggered by semi-auto mode, Horse Talisman will stop asking automatically for this combat.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-RAT_TALISMAN_CARD.title: Rat Talisman
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-RAT_TALISMAN_CARD.descri:
Add {Magic} cards from the exhaust pile to your hand. Cards that cost 0 stay 0; other cards cost *1* this turn. They gain *Ethereal* and *Exhaust*.
With *Rat Talisman*, retrieved cards do not gain *Ethereal*.
*Animal Talisman*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-RAT_TALISMAN_CARD.select: Choose cards to retrieve from the exhaust pile.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-OX_TALISMAN_CARD.title: Ox Talisman
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-OX_TALISMAN_CARD.descrip:
Enemy *Strength* and *Dexterity* cannot be higher than yours.
With *Ox Talisman*, enemy *Strength* cannot be higher than your *Strength* -3.
*Animal Talisman*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-TIGER_TALISMAN_SKILL_CAR:
Choose an enemy.
If their HP is higher than yours: Their *Strength* -{Magic}.
If their HP is lower than yours: Your *Strength* +{Magic}.
With *Tiger Talisman*, the *Strength* change is increased by 1.
*Animal Talisman*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-TIGER_TALISMAN_ATTACK_CA:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Compare HP percentage with the target.
If theirs is higher: Heal {Magic} HP.
If theirs is lower: Deal additional damage equal to 20% of their lost HP, currently {BonusDamage:diff()} for the target.
With *Tiger Talisman*, heal 5 HP and use 30% lost HP instead.
*Animal Talisman*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-RABBIT_TALISMAN_CARD.des:

With *Rabbit Talisman*, this card costs 1 less.
*Animal Talisman*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DRAGON_TALISMAN_CARD.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. If any enemy is killed, re-trigger this card's effect.
With *Dragon Talisman*, damage +8 and gains extra damage equal to twice the absolute value of your current *Strength*.
*Animal Talisman*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-HORSE_TALISMAN_CARD.desc:
At the end of this turn, heal HP equal to {IfUpgraded:show:40%|30%} (rounded down) of the total damage you dealt to enemies this turn.
With *Horse Talisman*, overhealing becomes Block at a 1:5 ratio.
*Animal Talisman*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-GOAT_TALISMAN_CARD.title: Sheep Talisman
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-GOAT_TALISMAN_CARD.descr:

With *Sheep Talisman*, affects ALL enemies.
*Animal Talisman*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-MONKEY_TALISMAN_CARD.des:

With *Monkey Talisman*, gain 12 Block.
*Animal Talisman*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-ROOSTER_TALISMAN_CARD.de:
Gain *Flight*: *Dexterity* +{Magic} and attack damage taken reduced by 50%. After taking 5 attack hits, you are shot down and *Stunned* for 1 turn. When shot down, lose the *Dexterity* from this power.
With *Rooster Talisman*, the hit count becomes 10 and being shot down no longer *Stuns* you; instead, lose 2 extra *Dexterity*.
*Animal Talisman*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DOG_TALISMAN_CARD.title: Dog Talisman
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DOG_TALISMAN_CARD.descri:
For the next {IfUpgraded:show:8|5} turns, fatal damage from enemies is prevented. When triggered, restore {Magic} HP and gain 1 *Intangible*.
With *Dog Talisman*, if this effect expires or combat ends without triggering, gain 1 Max HP.
*Animal Talisman*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PIG_TALISMAN_CARD.title: Pig Talisman
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PIG_TALISMAN_CARD.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Remove target's: *Strength*, *Artifact*, *Thorns*, *Intangible*, *Plating*, *Doom*, *Demise*, *Nemesis*, *Flutter*, *Hardened Shell*, *Soar*, and *Hard to Kill*. Apply {Magic} *Vulnerable*.
With *Pig Talisman*, affects ALL enemies.
*Animal Talisman*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DARK_PACT.title: Dark Pact
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SOULTRAP.title: Soul Trap
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SOULTRAP.description: Choose any number of cards to Exhaust. For each odd-numbered card exhausted, gain 1 *Strength*. For each even-numbered card exhausted, gain 1 *Dexterity*.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-FAKE_TALISMAN.title: Fake Talisman
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-FAKE_TALISMAN.descriptio: Draw {Magic} cards, then choose 1 card in hand to discard.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-TIGER_TALISMAN_YIN.title: Tiger Talisman Yin Jackie
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-TIGER_TALISMAN_YIN.descr:
Gain {Magic} Block for each card in hand except this card, up to {MaxBlock}. Current: {CalculatedBlock}.
*Team Jackie*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-TIGER_TALISMAN_YANG.desc:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. Each other card in hand reduces this card's base damage by 2, minimum 2.
*Team Jackie*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DRUNKEN_FIST.title: Drunken Fist
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DRUNKEN_FIST.description:
Spend all energy. Deal {MinDamage}-{MaxDamage} random damage to all enemies X times.
*Team Jackie*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SHADOW_QUEEN.title: Shadow Queen
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DEFLECT_AND_STRIKE.title: Deflect and Strike
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DEFLECT_AND_STRIKE.descr:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Whenever you fully block a normal enemy attack this turn, deal the blocked damage back to the attacker.
*Team Jackie*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-GIANT_JADE.title: Giant Jade
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SUPLEX.title: Suplex
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SUPLEX.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Damage = {Damage:diff()} + one eighth of the target's Max HP.
*Team Jackie*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-CLOSE_AT_HAND.title: Close at Hand
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-CLOSE_AT_HAND.descriptio:
Lose {HpLoss} HP. Gain Block equal to enemies' total attack intent damage +{IntentBonus}. Current: {CalculatedBlock}.
*Team Jackie*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SINGLE_PLANK_BRIDGE.desc:
Choose any number of cards in hand to Exhaust. Auto-play the top card of your draw pile that many times{IfUpgraded:show:+1|}.
*Team Jackie*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-AMBIDEXTERITY.title: Ambidexterity
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-AMBIDEXTERITY.descriptio:
Draw {Cards} cards. Choose 1 card in hand to discard, then choose 1 card in hand to put on top of your draw pile.
*Team Jackie*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-AMBIDEXTERITY.topDeckPro: Choose a card to put on top of your draw pile.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-JADE_STEALS_TALISMAN.des:
Add a random *Animal Talisman* card to your hand. It costs 0 this turn.
Exhaust.
*Team Jackie*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PETRIFICATION.title: Petrification
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PETRIFICATION.descriptio:
Apply 1 *Petrified*. Each stack makes the target take {Magic}% more attack damage, up to 10. At the start of its turn, it gains 1 *Strength* and 1 stack.
Exhaust.
*Team Jackie*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-FLATTEN.title: Flatten
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-FLATTEN.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Damage = 8 + the total number of cards in draw pile, hand, discard pile, and exhaust pile.
*Team Jackie*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-TARGET_IMBALANCE.title: Target Imbalance
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-TARGET_IMBALANCE.descrip:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If it deals unblocked damage, randomly change the target's intent and try not to increase its attack damage.
Exhaust.
*Team Jackie*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-CARD_FIRE_DEMON_QI.title: 火之恶魔·小龙
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-CARD_FIRE_DEMON_QI.descr:
给予所有敌人 {Magic} 层 *灼烧*。
处于 *潮湿* 状态的敌人会与之合成为 *高温蒸汽*。
（基础 *2* 层，升级 *3* 层）
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-CARD_MOUNTAIN_DEMON_QI.d: Retain. Deal damage equal to your current *Block*. If this kills an enemy, gain {Magic} *Max HP*.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-CARD_WIND_DEMON_QI.title: 风之恶魔·啸风
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-CARD_WIND_DEMON_QI.descr:
抽 {Magic} 张牌，选择 {DiscardCnt} 张手牌丢弃。
给予全体敌人 {WindAmt} 层 *风势*。
（*风势* 会将敌人身上的 *潮湿* 转化为同向层数的 *冻伤*，并加速火、冰类异常状态的结算与消耗。）
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-CARD_WATER_DEMON_QI.desc:
对所有敌人造成 {Damage:diff()} 点伤害。对其中的每个敌人：若其已有 *冻伤* 或 *冰狱*，给予 {Magic} 层 *冻伤*；否则给予 {Magic} 层 *潮湿*。
（*灼烧* 与 *潮湿* 会自动合成 *高温蒸汽*）小概率获得金币。
（基础 *2* 层，升级 *3* 层）
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-CARD_THUNDER_DEMON_QI.de:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Each time played this combat, costs 1 less (minimum 0).
Permanent damage +1 (current +{Growth}, up to +{Magic} per combat).
Multiple Thunder Demon cards grow independently.
If the target has *Wet* or *High Temp Steam*, this damage is doubled.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-CARD_EARTH_DEMON_QI.desc:
Unused *Block* does not disappear during this combat.
At end of turn, if you have no *Block*, lose {Magic} HP and gain *Block* equal to 1/8 of your Max HP.
Whenever you go *3* consecutive turns without taking damage, apply 1 *Earth Bind* to all enemies. Taking damage resets the count and removes *Earth Bind* and *Heavy Mire*.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-CARD_HEAVEN_DEMON_QI.des:
When attacking, trigger 1 stack each of the target's *Burning*, *Burning Heart*, *Frostbite*, and *Frost Hell*.
When an attack hits, has a 1/8 chance to apply 1 *Fear*; each listed anomaly on the target increases the chance by 1/8.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-CARD_MOON_DEMON_QI.title: 月之恶魔·咒蓝
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-CARD_MOON_DEMON_QI.descr:
Choose a moon effect: reverse yourself, gain an enemy reversal token, or uncap Demon Qi damage. In multiplayer, you may also gain an ally reversal token.
Exhaust.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-MOON_CHOICE_ENEMY_PREVIE: Gain a temporary 0-cost *Enemy Reversal* token. You choose the enemy when playing it.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-MOON_CHOICE_UNCAP_PREVIE: Gain *Uncap*. While any teammate has it, Demon Qi damage ignores its maximum cap.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-MOON_CHOICE_ALLY_PREVIEW: Gain a temporary 0-cost *Ally Reversal* token. You choose the ally when playing it.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-MOON_INVERT_ENEMY_TOKEN_:
Choose an enemy. Reverse its *Strength* and *Dexterity*.
Exhaust. Ethereal.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-MOON_INVERT_ALLY_TOKEN_C:
Choose an ally. Reverse their *Strength* and *Dexterity*.
Exhaust. Ethereal.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_QI.heaven.name: Heaven
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_QI.heaven.effect: When an attack hits, it has a 1/8 chance to apply 1 *Fear*.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_QI.earth.name: Earth
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_QI.earth.effect: After this card is played, your unused *Block* is not removed this turn.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_QI.wind.name: Wind
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_QI.wind.effect: Draw 2 cards and apply 2 *Wind* to all enemies.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_QI.thunder.name: Thunder
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_QI.thunder.effect: Each time this card is played this combat, reduce its cost by 1.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_QI.water.name: Water
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_QI.fire.name: Fire
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_QI.mountain.name: Mountain
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_QI.moon.name: Moon
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_QI.moon.effect: Once per combat, the first hit on an enemy with positive *Strength* reverses that *Strength* into a negative value.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_STORE_QI_PREVIEW_:
Store *{Qi}* Demon Qi in the Pan Ku Box.
Enchantment effect: {Effect}
Valid targets: {EnchantTargetType}.
Later, spend a Rest Site action to enchant a card with it.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_CANCEL_PREVIEW_CA:
Cancel this enchantment and return to the Rest Site.
This does not spend your rest action.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-EMERGENCY_ESCAPE.title: Emergency Escape
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-EMERGENCY_ESCAPE.descrip:
Gain {Plating} *Plating*.
For the next {Magic} turns, prevent and reflect debuffs from monsters.
*Team Jackie*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DEMON_CODEX.title: Demon Codex
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DEMON_CODEX.description:
*Shadowkhan* cards are affected by *Strength*, *Dexterity*, *Vulnerable*, *Weak*, and *Frail*, mixed together with *Dominion*.
Mask capacity +2.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-POSSESSION.title: Possession
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-POSSESSION.description:
Can only be played if you have not played an Attack this turn.
After playing this, you cannot play Attacks this turn.
Stun the target for 1 turn. Steal and clear its *Strength*, *Artifact*, *Ritual*, *Plating*, and *Block*.
Apply {Debuff} *Vulnerable*, {Debuff} *Weak*, and {Mangle} *Debilitate*.
Exhaust.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SHADOW_GUARD.title: Shadow Guard
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SHADOW_GUARD.description:
Whenever *Ninja-khan* reduces a monster's HP, gain that much *Block*.{IfUpgraded:show:
Damage absorbed by Block also grants *Block*.|}
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-RABBIT_STRIKE.title: Rabbit Strike
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-RABBIT_STRIKE.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a copy of this card to your discard pile.
With *Rabbit Talisman*, draw 1 card.
If an *Ah Fu* card was played this turn: Gain [E], up to 2 times each turn.
*Ah Fu*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-BLACK_HAND_BITTER_CHOICE:
Lose {HpLoss} HP. Gain {Magic} Energy. Draw {Magic} cards.
Gain {Stats} temporary *Strength* and {Stats} temporary *Dexterity* this turn.
Next turn, all cards cost 1 more this turn.
*Blackhand*

SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-CURSE_TOHRU.description:
When drawn, Attacks cost 1 more.
Cost: {TaxState}.
At end of turn, if you played no Attacks this turn, lose 6 HP.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-CURSE_JACKIE.title: Jackie
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-CURSE_JADE.title: Jade
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-CURSE_JADE.description: When drawn, discard 1 other card and put 1 *Dazed* on top of your draw pile.

SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-CURSE_BLACK.description:
When drawn, Skills cost 1 more.
Cost: {TaxState}.
At end of turn, gain 1 *Vulnerable*.
